# eetree-sim 1
# name voltage-multiplier-half
# param VP 14.14
# param f 50
# param C 0.0001
# param RL 10000
# let dt = 1/(f*400)
# let sp = 40
$ 1 ${dt} ${sp} 50 ${VP*2} 50
v 64 192 64 128 0 1 ${f} ${VP} 0 0 0.5
c 104 96 152 96 0 ${C} 0 0
d 192 184 192 136 1 0.805904783
d 288 136 288 184 1 0.805904783
c 216 224 264 224 0 ${C} 0 0
r 352 264 352 312 0 ${RL}
g 352 312 352 328 0 0
g 64 256 64 272 0 0
207 416 224 448 224 0 VOUT
w 64 128 64 96 0
w 64 192 64 224 0
w 64 96 104 96 0
w 152 96 192 96 0
w 64 224 192 224 0
w 192 96 192 136 0
w 192 184 192 224 0
w 288 96 288 136 0
w 288 184 288 224 0
w 192 224 216 224 0
w 264 224 288 224 0
w 192 96 288 96 0
w 288 224 352 224 0
w 352 224 352 264 0
w 352 224 416 224 0
w 64 224 64 256 0
x 64 56 264 60 0 18 半波倍压整流（Greinacher）
x 64 368 264 372 0 14 电容按计算器中的 C 取相同值；V1 峰值 ${si(VP)}V、${si(f)}Hz，负载 RL ＝ ${si(RL)}Ω
o 0 2 0 4098 ${VP*2} 0.01 0 2 8 0
o 8 64 0 4098 ${VP*2} 0.01 1 1
